summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Strategy field + 3D card ring across /live-signals, /injector, and /future-signals. All 8 requested test areas passed. Field renders after market pick (+future-next-button) with default 'Coco SmartFlow' visible in <prefix>-strategy-value and matching note; tapping opens the ring dialog with all 5 faces (smartflow, alphagrid, auralis, zenx, algoryx) whose images are all fully loaded (naturalWidth>0). Escape, close button, and backdrop all dismiss the ring without changing the selection. Click at centre of stage always selects the currently-front card and closes the ring — verified two distinct picks (Coco Algoryx, then after ~4.5s rotation Coco Zenx) on each of the 3 pages. FPS probe at 390x844 with the ring open returned ~60 fps on live / injector / future. Backdrop uses solid rgb(7,4,26) with backdrop-filter:none (opaque, nothing behind bleeds through). Post-generation result chips <prefix>-strategy-used display the picked strategy on all three pages. No horizontal overflow on mobile or 1920x1080 desktop, ring panel fits viewport, no console errors captured.
critical_code_review_comments: strategy-select.tsx (~309 lines) is fine size-wise but the ring animation depends on the click's mouse.click landing on the front-most face — this works because faces at ±72deg are z-transformed behind the front one. If a face is enlarged or the ring is dragged mid-animation, hit-testing may fall on a side card; current onClick + data-idx fallback correctly handles that.
The ring uses a body scroll lock (document.body.style.overflow='hidden') but does not restore any prior inline overflow value — acceptable since default is '' but worth noting for nested modals.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright note: session cookies do NOT persist between separate mcp_browser_automation calls — the login flow must be re-run at the start of every script. To pick a non-default strategy via the ring, click the field, wait ~3s (~60deg auto-rotation ≈ one card face) then page.mouse.click at the centre of <prefix>-strategy-stage. Result chip testids: live-strategy-used / injector-strategy-used / future-strategy-used — generation takes up to ~30s (live/injector) and ~40s (future); use wait_for_selector with a generous timeout.
